description: This Java class `CacheSwitchCommandHandler` handles commands to switch cache types within the Fineract infrastructure. It implements the `CommandHandler` interface for processing `CacheSwitchRequest` objects and returning `CacheSwitchResponse` objects, using the `CacheWritePlatformService` to perform the cache switching logic.

classes.name: CacheSwitchCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring-managed component that handles cache switching commands, utilizing dependency injection, transactional processing, and logging.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the incoming command to switch the cache type and returns the response with the result of the operation.
